case_study_packaging.headline: PE-backed residential HVAC & plumbing platform unlocks $927K in annual savings in just 6 months with Treya Partners
case_study_packaging.client_problem_statement: Cascade Residential Services, a fast-growing platform of 13 HVAC, plumbing and electrical brands backed by Trive Capital and LP First Capital, managed more than $32 million in annual spend through highly decentralized branch-level purchasing. The fragmented approach left the company paying inconsistent prices to OEMs and distributors and missing out on enterprise-level rebate programs. With margin expansion and $16.6 million in expected value creation on the line, Cascade turned to Treya Partners to quickly centralize sourcing and capture hard savings across critical direct and indirect categories.
case_study_packaging.client_problem_anonymized: A fast-growing residential HVAC, plumbing and electrical services platform managed more than $32 million in annual spend through highly decentralized branch-level purchasing. The fragmented approach left the company paying inconsistent prices to OEMs and distributors and missing out on enterprise-level rebate programs. With a focus on operational efficiency and margin improvement, the organization turned to Treya Partners to quickly centralize sourcing and capture hard savings across critical direct and indirect categories.
approach_summary: Conducted a rapid spend diagnostic covering nine categories and $32.9 M in baseline spend to identify $0.87–$1.7 M in addressable savings opportunities.
Renegotiated national pricebooks and back-end rebate programs with Carrier and Rheem, securing rebate tiers up to 15 % and front-end price improvements without disrupting field operations.
Launched competitive events with Lennox and Johnstone and benchmarked pricing, positioning the client to capture an additional $397K in OEM rebates now in final review.
Ran a multi-vendor RFP for HVACR & plumbing supplies, memorializing unit-price reductions via MOUs with Hughes Supply, Baker Distributing and R.E. Michel.
Designed a single-provider uniform solution through the Rampart GPO and Unifirst, cutting rental costs by 43 % and standardizing service levels across all branches.
case_study_packaging.value_delivered_blurb: Treya Partners has delivered $927K in verified annual run-rate savings—already 6 % above the engagement’s high-end forecast—while locking in $426K of those savings under fully executed contracts within the first 120 days. The program generates a 2.2× return on Treya’s fixed project fee and establishes national pricing, rebate governance and centralized sourcing processes that will continue to yield benefits as the platform scales.
where_we_were_unique: Delivered first hard-dollar savings within four months despite limited SKU-level data and decentralized purchasing.
Leveraged deep HVAC OEM relationships to unlock national rebate tiers unavailable through traditional distributor channels.
Balanced rapid savings capture with zero disruption to field technicians by preserving critical supplier relationships.
Exceeded the private equity sponsor’s 2× ROI requirement while simplifying the client’s procurement infrastructure for future add-on acquisitions.
